predictions.selection_reason: User-controlled trustedOrigins option -> constructs flashvars parameter -> passed to Flash security configuration
predictions.source_summary: origins array is built from options.trustedOrigins and options.trustedDomains, which are passed into the ZeroClipboard constructor or set via setDefaults. These options are user-controlled (caller-provided).
predictions.sink_summary: The constructed flashvars string is embedded into HTML as a param/embed attribute 'flashvars', which is passed to the Flash object. Flash uses trustedOrigins for security policy (cross-domain communication).
predictions.guard_summary: encodeURIComponent is applied to the joined origins list, providing URL encoding but no validation of origin format or security policy. No allowlist validation; any string or array from caller is accepted.
predictions.risk_pattern: User-controlled trustedOrigins/trustedDomains options are encoded and passed to Flash security configuration via flashvars, potentially allowing an attacker to set arbitrary trusted origins, influencing Flash's cross-domain policy.
called_function_context: _bridge called from ZeroClipboard constructor (line 232) when Flash is supported
predictions.context_summary: The _vars function constructs a flashvars string from options. In _bridge, flashvars is inserted into HTML object/embed tags for the Flash movie. The trustedOrigins parameter configures Flash's security policy for cross-domain communication.
unresolved_facts: Exact impact of malicious trustedOrigins on Flash security policy (e.g., whether it can bypass same-origin restrictions).
Whether the Flash movie enforces any validation on trustedOrigins beyond what is passed.
